Stanley M. Noszka served as a member of the Pennsylvania State Senate.
Stanley M. Noszka's term in the Pennsylvania State Senate was from 1967 to 1978.
Stanley M. Noszka played professional basketball in the 1940s.
Stanley M. Noszka played for the Youngstown Bears in the National Basketball League during 1945-46.
Stanley M. Noszka played for the Pittsburgh Ironmen in the Basketball Association of America during 1946-47.
Stanley M. Noszka played for the Boston Celtics in the Basketball Association of America during 1947-48.
